rationale: Phase-4 Stage 3 / WU-B (Sparse Volumes) mutation baseline. Run DIRECTLY (not via run-mutation.sh). The mutation gate is SOFT_WARN-advisory (spec § 2.13, Phase-4 A3 honesty correction). The sparse-volume LOGIC lives in common_warp.sparse.mask (the dense active-cell mask + topology hash + manifest projection); common_warp.sparse.volume / _kernels are thin Warp glue (wp.Volume load + a lookup kernel) that mutmut cannot mutate meaningfully (Any-typed Warp surface, no branching logic) and whose correctness is gated by the load/lookup tests against the committed .nvdb fixture. The C++ bit_physics::nanovdb writer/reader (where the write actually happens — Warp grid allocation is CUDA-only) is exercised by its doctest ctest including a 40-trial randomized property test.

targets.delta_note: Initial measure 0.6316 (24/38); lifted to 0.8684 (33/38) with constraining tests that exercise the default origin (no-origin == explicit (0,0,0)), the absolute-coord shift (coords = idx + origin, killing the +/- mutant), and the nanovdb encoding branch. The 5 residual survivors are the dataclass `origin` field-default mutants that `ActiveMask.from_dense` bypasses (it always passes origin explicitly) plus equivalent default-arg mutants — accepted (default-arg survivors on a path the primary constructor does not exercise).
